mutants.name: drop-safeguards-field
mutants.new: req.httpBody = Data(String(decoding: body, as: UTF8.self).replacingOccurrences(of: "\"safeguards\"", with: "\"sg\"").utf8)

mutants.name: rewrite-response-frame
mutants.new:
frame.append(Data(String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self).replacingOccurrences(of: "safeguard_results", with: "results").utf8))
            frame.append(contentsOf: [13, 10])
            outstanding += frame.count
